name: Kristy-Lee Powell
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Knox Mindfulness is a holistic wellness practice based at the foot of the Dandenong Ranges. With a strong focus on looking at the individual, their issues, their needs, and goals as a whole; aiming at bringing greater awareness and change to the individual’s life through deeper understanding and personal growth. Knox Mindfulness is passionate about supporting individuals through challenging moments in life.

name: Kate Reimer
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Kate is a registered counsellor working with adults, youth and children. Working from a trauma-informed approach, she prioritises establishing a safe and non-judgemental therapeutic relationship in which clients can begin to explore the issues important to them. Whether you are facing issues of grief and loss, depression or anxiety, childhood trauma, or you are wanting to live a more meaningful and fulfilling life, counselling can provide additional resources for healing, growing and living more authentically.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Sarah FOUNTAS
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: An integrative practice style is used including a range of modalities such as CBT, Narrative, Solution Focused, Motivational Interviewing and Internal Family Systems. All practise carries Trauma Informed and Trauma Informed background and research based therapeutic approaches. ​ With a background in applied Linguistics and as a second language speaker, social, cross-cultural, religious and economic factors are always respected. These inform world-views that need to be appreciated and where appropriate integrated into the therapeutic process.

name: Priscilla Lund
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Priscilla is the lead Clinical Counsellor Island Counselling and lead Well-being coach at Mindflex. ​At Island Counselling ( https://www.islandcounselling.com.au/ ), Priscilla offers professional, confidential counselling in Cowes, Phillip Island, for young adults, adults, older adults, and couples. Specialising in life transitions, Gottman Method couples therapy, relationships, mental health and well-being​ (stress, anxiety and depression), grief, career development, WorkSafe and NDIS support. Providing telehealth and in-person therapy to help you navigate challenges with resilience and confidence.

name: Linda Graham
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Linda is a warm, compassionate, and client-centred counselling practitioner who supports adults, youths and families experiencing anxiety, stress, relationship difficulties, life transitions, grief, low self-esteem, and emotional challenges. Linda's approach is grounded in creating a safe, confidential, and non-judgemental space where clients can feel heard, respected, understood, and supported. Linda works collaboratively with each client, recognising that everyone’s experiences and goals are unique.
